First, convert 38 weeks and 6 days to days:  
38 weeks × 7 days/week = 266 days  
Add 6 days → 272 days total to subtract.

Start date: 1486-08-25  
Subtract 272 days:  
August has 31 days, so going back 25 days lands on July 31 (1486-07-31).  
Remaining days: 272 − 25 = 247 days earlier from July 31.

Work backwards month by month:  
July 31 → June 30 (31 days back) → 216 days left  
June 30 → May 31 (30 days back) → 186 days left  
May 31 → April 30 (31 days back) → 155 days left  
April 30 → March 31 (30 days back) → 125 days left  
March 31 → February 28 in 1486 (31 days back) → 94 days left  
February 28 → January 31 (28 days back) → 66 days left  
January 31 → December 31, 1485 (31 days back) → 35 days left  
December 31 → November 26, 1485 (35 days back).

FINAL_ANSWER: 1485-11-26
